purpose: Blind geometric hypothesis classes for public HST imagery. These are measurement targets, not semantic claims or evidence of artificial origin.

targets.description: Unexpected connected-component, hole, branch, or boundary topology relative to fixed null models.
Unusually strong or unusually constrained rotational/reflection symmetry under fixed transforms.
Repeated spatial motifs at separated locations or scales that exceed the fixed null distribution.
Boundary segments unusually close to simple geometric primitives compared with nulls.
Spatial features showing unusually persistent alignment over large separations.
A deliberately non-semantic shape class for elongated body-plus-lateral-extension morphology. The system measures geometry only; it must never label an object as a flag or infer intent.
Candidate morphology occupying an extreme tail of the empirical geometric feature distribution. 'Unusual' means statistically rare under the chosen null, not physically impossible.

interpretation_rule: No target class is evidence of intelligence, artificiality, messaging, or impossibility. A candidate is only a reproducible geometric anomaly requiring independent astronomical investigation.
